statement:
∀ (a t : ℝ) (f : KdVPlan.Coeff), a≤t → KdVPlan.Smooth f → KdVPlan.ZeroMean f →
KdVPlan.Cst a f t=KdVPlan.scale (1/3) (KdVPlan.J t f (KdVPlan.F a f t))-KdVPlan.scale (1/6) (KdVPlan.tri a t (fun _ => f) (fun _ => f) (fun _ => f))
proof:
intro a t f hat hfs hzf
have hf0 : KdVPlan.MemH 0 f := by simpa using hfs 0
have hf1 : KdVPlan.MemH 1 f := by simpa using hfs 1
have hf2 : KdVPlan.MemH 2 f := by simpa using hfs 2
have hcf := (yui_aux_0030 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).1 0 a t f hf0
have hcf1 := (yui_aux_0030 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).1 1 a t f hf1
have hFF := yui_aux_0042 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013 a t f hat hf0 hzf
have hF0 := (yui_aux_0038 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).1 0 1 a t _ (by norm_num) hFF.1
have hBff := (yui_aux_0041 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).2.1 a t _ _ hcf1 hcf1
have hD := (yui_aux_0030 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).2.2 0 a t _ (fun _ => (1/2:ℂ)) hBff continuousOn_const
rcases (yui_aux_0034 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).1 0 a t _ hF0 with ⟨Cg,_,hCg⟩
rcases (yui_aux_0034 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).1 0 a t _ hD with ⟨Cd,_,hCd⟩
have hder := yui_aux_0062 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013 a t Cg Cd f (KdVPlan.F a f) (fun r => KdVPlan.scale (1/2) (KdVPlan.B r f f)) hf2 hzf hCg hCd (fun r _ => (yui_aux_0019 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).2.1 a r f f) hFF.2.1
have hJ := (yui_aux_0041 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).2.2 a t _ _ hcf hF0
have hBC := (yui_aux_0041 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).2.1 a t _ _ hcf1 hFF.1
have hJB := (yui_aux_0041 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).2.2 a t _ _ hcf hBff
have hpc := yui_aux_0063 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013 a t f hfs
have htri := h_T005.2.2.2.1 a t (fun _ => f) (fun _ => f) (fun _ => f) hat hpc hpc hpc (fun _ _ => ⟨hzf,hzf,hzf⟩)
have hBmem : ∀ r, KdVPlan.MemH 0 (KdVPlan.B r f f) := by
  rcases (yui_aux_0019 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).2.2.1 with ⟨C,hC,hb⟩
  exact fun r => (hb r f f hf1 hf1).1
have hsym : ∀ r, KdVPlan.J r f (KdVPlan.B r f f)=KdVPlan.J r (KdVPlan.B r f f) f :=
  fun r => h_T005.2.1 r f (KdVPlan.B r f f) hf0 (hBmem r) hzf ((yui_aux_0019 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013).1 r f f)
funext k
have hcBC := yui_aux_0031 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013 0 a t _ hBC k
have hcJB := yui_aux_0031 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013 1 a t _ hJB k
have hder' : ∀ r∈Ioo a t, HasDerivAt (fun s => KdVPlan.J s f (KdVPlan.F a f s) k) (3*KdVPlan.B r f (KdVPlan.F a f r) k+(1/2:ℂ)*KdVPlan.J r f (KdVPlan.B r f f) k) r := by
  intro r hr
  simpa only [(yui_aux_0064 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013 r f (KdVPlan.B r f f) (1/2)).1,KdVPlan.scale] using hder r hr k
have hiBC := hcBC.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc hat
have hiJB := hcJB.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc hat
have hFTC := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt_of_le hat
  (yui_aux_0031 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013 1 a t _ hJ k)
  hder' ((hiBC.const_mul 3).add (hiJB.const_mul (1/2:ℂ)))
rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add (hiBC.const_mul 3) (hiJB.const_mul (1/2:ℂ)),intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul] at hFTC
have hFa : KdVPlan.F a f a=0 := by funext j; simp [KdVPlan.F,KdVPlan.stage,KdVPlan.timeInt,KdVPlan.scale]
rw [hFa,(yui_aux_0064 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013 a f f 1).2] at hFTC
have htri' : (∫ r in a..t, KdVPlan.J r f (KdVPlan.B r f f) k)=KdVPlan.tri a t (fun _ => f) (fun _ => f) (fun _ => f) k := by
  change _ = _
  rw [← htri]
  unfold KdVPlan.timeInt
  apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
  intro r _
  exact congrFun (hsym r) k
rw [htri'] at hFTC
change (∫ r in a..t, KdVPlan.B r f (KdVPlan.F a f r) k)=(1/3:ℂ)*KdVPlan.J t f (KdVPlan.F a f t) k-(1/6:ℂ)*KdVPlan.tri a t (fun _ => f) (fun _ => f) (fun _ => f) k
have hh := hFTC
simp only [Pi.zero_apply,sub_zero] at hh
linear_combination (1/3:ℂ)*hh
